closer_windows.resolved: Pedestrians pass in the foreground; the red ball leaves the wooden toy, descends to the pavement and moves away as the view follows it. This supports the requested action but does not validate exact physical realism.

product_from_film: Runway Gen-4 generates images and video using references to keep objects, characters and settings recognizable.

lessons.keep: Use one recognizable object to connect capture, generation, selection and animation.
lessons.avoid: Letting selected showcase clips stand in for a reproducible workflow or hiding release qualifications in closing speech.
lessons.open: Generation latency, retries, full editing process, typical consistency, exact reflection and physics fidelity, and all heard sound remain unverified.
try: For Tin, photograph a package and carry that exact package through reference loading, creative selection and a final campaign asset.
Add a small availability label beside each demonstrated capability and a final available/coming-soon card.
